verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own AI assistant is documented to "check your calendar," and it has a built-in Calendar integration that works "without ever leaving your inbox." That gives some first-party calendar access inside the client. However, nothing in the evidence shows a visible calendar view, responding to invites, or creating events. Missing for 10: a native calendar view, invite RSVP from within emails, event creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the calendar features.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client

citations.quote: it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more.
